propositions: When completion verifier exhausts search budget without refuting criteria, it fails instead of auto-resuming, requiring operator to manually re-run the close command
The verdict cache banks per-criterion PASSes even on overall FAIL, so a re-run with the same arguments will seed credited criteria and concentrate budget on formerly-insufficient ones
Auto-resume should be bounded by attempt count (verify.auto_resume_max, default 2) and qualified only when failure is insufficiency-only (all unmet criteria carry evidence_sufficient: false marker)
Resumption must be dispatched only when prior attempt strictly increased cache-credited PASS count; zero progress indicates the next re-run would spin identically and should surface failure instead
Auto-resume loop sits at the shared close-gate verification seam (close_precheck._completion_precheck wrapping llm.verify_completion) so it applies to CLI, MCP, and library close paths uniformly
